disclaimer: Simplified estimate for Philippine resident individuals under TRAIN law. SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG contributions, 13th month pay exemption, and non-resident rates are not included.

regimes.label: TRAIN Law Individual (2024) (Resident / Citizen)
regimes.notes: Under TRAIN law, income up to ₱250,000 is tax-exempt. Simplified progressive rates applied. Mandatory contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) are not deducted here.

regimes.label: Non-Resident Alien (Not Engaged in Trade/Business)
regimes.notes: A non-resident alien not engaged in trade or business in the Philippines is taxed at a flat 25% on gross Philippine-source income, with no deductions.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 180+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
